listing.summary: A faction pack containing a faction with ships, weapons and strikecraft.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the Europa Federation faction with new ships, weapons, and strikecraft.

description:
A faction pack containing a faction with ships, weapons and strikecraft.

Two star systems are added in the south of the sector, "Europa" and "Carthage".
The Europa Federation prefer energy weapons and have a emphasis on point defence.

This is very much work in progress and something I do in my spare time.

This is my first mod and I am looking for any helpful feedback or suggestions.
I would be grateful if someone could assist me in creating some missions and stations!

Requires:
Magic, Shader and LunaLib

Download

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NbOv77Q0GEERnH8pilU4WxMzSjbhiG3X/view?usp=sharing

gallery.aiCaption: A wide banner featuring the text 'EUROPA FEDERATION' in large red and blue letters next to a spaceship sprite.
The mod's logo showing a ship inside a circle of stars with the text 'EUROPA FEDERATION' and 'EF' on either side.
A chart displaying various ship sprites categorized as Auxiliary, Frigates, Destroyers, Cruisers, and Capital ships under the header 'EUROPA FEDERATION'.
A chart listing Strikecraft, Weaponry, and ShipSystems with their corresponding icons and names like 'Tartarus Coil' and 'Ion Field'.
A digital painting of a large grey and yellow spaceship launching fighters near a blue planet.
A digital painting of a red and white ship crashing into clouds while another blue ship flies nearby.
